name: $p = \rho g h$
content: Pressure in terms of height of liquid column / liquid pressure

name: $p = p_{atm} + \rho g h$
content: True pressure at a depth in a liquid

name: $p_{gas} = p_{atm} - \rho g h$
content: Gas pressure lower than atmospheric pressure measured by a manometer

name: $p_{gas} = p_{atm} + \rho g h$
content: Gas pressure higher than atmospheric pressure measured by a manometer

name: $F = V \rho g$
content: Buoyant force or upward thrust (Archimedes' principle)

name: $w_f = \rho V g - \rho_0 V g$
content: Apparent weight of a body immersed in a liquid

name: $\frac{w_f}{w_i} = \frac{\rho - \rho_0}{\rho}$
content: Ratio of apparent weight to actual weight

name: $\frac{\rho}{\rho_0} = \frac{V_s}{V}$
content: Condition for a floating body (ratio of densities equals ratio of immersed volume to total volume)

name: $\frac{F_{in}}{A_{in}} = \frac{F_{out}}{A_{out}}$
content: Pascal's law relation for hydraulic press and lift

name: $F_{in} l_{in} = F_{out} l_{out}$
content: Conservation of work in an ideal hydraulic press or lift
